svg.aria-label: About. I build full-stack products: web, mobile, and the AI inside them. I'm a full-stack software engineer in Lahore. I build complete products end to end: the web app, the mobile app, the back end and database behind them, and the admin tools a team runs on its own. Recent work includes a delivery platform with dispatch and driver apps, and a company website with a store and an admin panel. I also build AI agents that talk to customers for real businesses: voice agents that answer the phone, assistants that reply on websites and by text, and the automation that turns each conversation into an order or a task. What I care about is simple: systems that work in production, every day. Web apps: React and Next.js front ends, with Node, NestJS or Laravel behind them. Mobile apps: React Native apps for drivers, managers and stores. AI agents and automation: Voice, chat and text agents, and the follow-up work after every conversation. Back end and data: APIs, PostgreSQL, Supabase and Firebase, and the admin tools a business runs on daily.
